title: Helen McCall's Sol Foundation white paper on UAPs and financial stability

tellings.quote: Helen McCall wrote a white paper for the soul foundation on this exact question of essentially UAPs and financial stability risk

plain: A writer named Helen McCall is said to have written a white paper, a short policy report, for the Sol Foundation, a research group, on whether UAPs (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs) could be a risk to financial stability. A researcher named Matthew Pines brings it up in passing, without saying more about what it found. He mentions it because, in his telling, it takes on exactly the question of what an official admission about UFOs could do to markets.
